# RangRiti (रंगरीति)

> RangRiti is an Indian marketplace website and Android app for discovering and
> booking verified mehndi (henna) artists across all 41 districts of Rajasthan,
> India — including Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer, Bikaner and Alwar.

## What RangRiti offers

- Browse verified bridal, Arabic and traditional Rajasthani mehndi artists with
  photo portfolios, star ratings, years of experience and transparent hourly rates.
- Artists are geo-tagged with GPS coordinates, so customers can find the nearest
  artist and see the distance on a map.
- Book a preferred date and time slot, chat with the artist in-app, and pay
  online via UPI or in cash.
- Every artist is manually verified (government ID + bank documents) before
  appearing in search results.
- Customer login via mobile number & password or Google account.
- Bilingual interface: English and Hindi (हिंदी).
- Cancellation policy: full refund when cancelling 24+ hours before the session;
  tiered refunds after that.

## Key pages

- Home / landing: https://rangritii-api.vercel.app/
- Customer login & sign up: https://rangritii-api.vercel.app/auth/customer-login
- Artist login: https://rangritii-api.vercel.app/auth/artist-login
- Artist registration: https://rangritii-api.vercel.app/auth/artist-register

## Audience

Brides, families and event planners in Rajasthan looking for mehndi artists for
weddings (शादी), engagements, Karva Chauth, Teej, Diwali, Eid and other
festivals; and mehndi artists looking to receive online bookings.
